This customized, purple-colored [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|'''TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank''']]&mdash;also called a '''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fighter tank'''&mdash;was a maneuverable, fast-attack [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertank]] used by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] piloted a [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]] marked with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]{{'s}} characteristic purple colors. Though [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fighter tanks were generally manned by a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]], copilot and [[Clone gunner/Legends|gunner]], the speed and maneuverability of Mace Windu's tank responded well to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]-enhanced skills of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] without the assistance additional [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] crew members.

Armed with a turret mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and dual heavy cannons that can fire [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], the tank was further modified with an onboard [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], as well as greater [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] power than most other fighter tanks were equipped with.

==History==
During the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], three [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] attacked Mace Windu's fighter tank while he made his way to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]{{'s}} hangar to confront the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]]. They dealt heavy damage to his tank, but he managed to penetrate their shields, overpowering and destroying them.

The tank was later used during the [[Battle of Thule]], when Mace Windu commanded ground forces around [[Thule/Legends|Thule]]{{'s}} capital city of [[Kesiak]]. A [[Dreadnought battle tank]] piloted by [[Cydon Prax]] then arrived, destroying the Jedi fighter tank and forcing Windu to travel on foot to complete his mission.
